changelog:
- Native Home Buttons & Menu: Permanently resolved unresponsive buttons and preview toasts by ensuring native bridge binding in the app environment.
- Dual-Screen Multi-Deck Split View: Added interactive control bar with dedicated close button, deck swap button, and smooth touch-drag split resize.
- Webpage Scrolling Glitch Fix: Static viewport bounds during scrolling to eliminate touch-coordinate stutter when the toolbar is positioned at the top.
- Expanding Command Card & Search Suggestions: Dynamic input expansion on focus and instant autocomplete suggestions dropdown from browsing history.
- On-Device AI Executive Summary & TTS: Flowing paragraph summary layout with clear headings and a toggleable Male/Female voice TTS engine.
- Anti-Fingerprint Neural Cloak: Mathematical micro-perturbations on canvas and audio contexts to defeat browser fingerprinting.
- X (Twitter) & Instagram Fixes: Preserved activity notifications and resolved external app intent navigation loops.
